name: Big word behind the speaker
description: Huge condensed word printed on a clean background BEHIND the speaker, who is cut out and stays in front; a small spaced label sits above the word, and the word can be struck through.
use_when: A hook or a punchy statement where one word carries the line (CANCEL, EDITING, TODAY); openings and closing calls to action.

word.help: the one big word, 3-10 letters reads best

kicker.help: small label above the word, e.g. 'YOU CAN'

accent.help: word in the accent colour instead of ink

strike.help: strike the word through halfway (for 'not this')

speaker_scale.help: 0.7-1.0; smaller shows more of the word

fade_from.help: 0.3-0.95: fade the cut-out body out from this height of the frame down (hides a mic, hand or prop near the lens); null keeps the full body
